scope: Pinned standard Envoy catalog: all 59 populated PGV rule paths and 86 path combinations, using 90 representative fields and 310 field-boundary outcomes, plus the separately locked whole-message, oneof, PGV and Protovalidate corpora. This is finite behavioral evidence, not exhaustive input-space or arbitrary-schema equivalence.
exclusions: Four named NaN range differences in sources.lock.json are accepted: Protovalidate rejects and Go PGV accepts.
Seven prerecorded relative-time timestamp cases are excluded per the pinned upstream loader policy; the selected catalog has no timestamp rules.
680 PGV harness cases outside the selected populated rule paths are excluded by pgv-conformance.lock.json.

Opaque Any payloads are not automatically unpacked or validated. Exact Go error text and order, arbitrary custom descriptors/rules, broader schema catalogs and newer upstream revisions are outside this claim.
